_help: Copied to workspace/config.json on first run; refresh.py and the panel read that copy. To track another app, add a block under apps and switch activeApp. Field help: _fields below. / TR: Kopyası workspace/config.json olarak kullanılır; başka bir uygulama için apps altına blok ekleyip activeApp'i değiştir.

_fields.name: App name as it appears in the store; the panel header and tag generation use it
_fields.emoji: Emoji shown in the panel header and the browser tab icon
_fields.tagline: Small line under the panel header
_fields.iosId: Numeric App Store id (apps.apple.com/.../id123456789 → 123456789). 0 if the app is not on iOS
_fields.playId: Google Play package name (play.google.com/...?id=com.x.y → com.x.y). Leave empty if the app is not on Play
_fields.goal: Download target shown in the Reports tab
_fields.country: Primary store country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase)
_fields.countries: Country codes the ranking scan covers
_fields.rateLimitSeconds: Pause between store requests during a scan; raise it if the stores start throttling
_fields.brandTerms: Competitor brand terms (e.g. names of big competitors). The audit checks they never appear in VISIBLE store text
_fields.downloadAssets: Download store icons and screenshots into workspace/ during the scan
_fields.keywords: Search phrases to track; the radar measures your ranking for each
_fields.screenHeadings: Source-language headings for the screenshot strips (used by Creative Studio)
_fields.competitors: Competitor list; ios_id is numeric, play_id is the package name. Use 0 / empty when one is missing
